description: This header file declares functions to create messages regarding camera events (add, remove, update) for communication with a server. It is part of a larger SDK managing camera devices, providing message creation interfaces.

methods.name: createCameraAddedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message informing the server that a new camera has been added.

methods.name: createCameraRemovedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message informing the server that a camera was removed, identified by its endpoint ID.

methods.name: createCameraUpdatedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message informing the server that a camera's details were updated.
